# SEO Content Brief

`seo-content-brief` · v1.1.0 · Design · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/seo-content-brief/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** What should this page answer, for which search intent, and is the brief complete enough to hand to a writer?

**Inputs:** Target query, the audience and their awareness state, what currently ranks for it, existing pages on the topic, and the business outcome the page should drive

**Output:** A writer-ready brief — intent classification, the 40-60 word answer block, H2/H3 structure, entities and subtopics to cover, citation and statistic targets, internal links, schema type, and success criteria

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill seo-content-brief`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/seo-content-brief/resources/brief-check.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/seo-content-brief/resources/brief-check.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Intent is read from the titles you paste, by signal-word patterns, one vote per title. It does not fetch the SERP or model the search engine; when the tally is close, read the titles yourself. With no titles, intent is inferred.
- The cannibalisation check sees only the existing pages you list with their intent after a dash. A page you leave out, or list without its intent, is not checked.
- It checks the brief is complete and well formed (a 40-60 word answer block, question headings, named sources), not that the answer is right or the sources are real.

**Review before acting:** The content lead checks the live SERP for the target query and the site's existing pages on the topic, and confirms each named source exists and supports its claim, before the brief goes to a writer.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/seo-content-brief](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/seo-content-brief)
